meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: WQXR: ad banners and newsletter box, plus story tile, social, recently played and footer controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: rendered DOM of www.wqxr.org home (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA), logged out, captured with headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved DOM. WQXR is an Ember app (WNYC/New York Public Radio) with readable layout classes. Fixtures real.html and desktop-real.html are structural captures with text stripped; `data-keep` marks the player, the Listen buttons, the stream banner and story links.

LIVE counts (phone and desktop alike): `.header-ad-wrapper` 1, `.leaderboard-ad` 1, `.dfp-ad` 1 (the empty DoubleClick leaderboard slot), `.newsletter-signup` 1, `.brick__item` 9 (story tiles; their pictures are inline CSS backgrounds, so dimming or blurring acts on the whole tile), `.nypr-social-icons` 1, `.playlist-history` 1, `.sitechrome-footer` 1.

The persistent player, the live stream banner and the Listen buttons are never targeted. The original cookie and app-banner rules matched nothing and are kept. NOT verified: show, story and article pages, the on-demand player page, any donation or membership pop-up (none appeared in the capture), logged-in state.
